physico.title: Physico - Physiotherapy App
physico.desc: Physico is a mobile and web application developed to reduce the challenges faced by patients with limited mobility in accessing physiotherapy centers. It provides a chat room that facilitates communication between patients and doctors. Patients can easily access details about assigned exercises, such as videos, descriptions, sets, and repetitions.
physico.subdesc: The web version is built with React, Redux Toolkit, and Bootstrap, while the mobile version uses React Native, Expo, and CSS. The backend is developed using Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io, and MongoDB. Physico is designed with a focus on high performance and scalability.

rocket.title: Rocket - Cryptocurrency Platform
rocket.desc: Rocket is a modern, secure, and user-friendly exchange platform where users can buy and sell cryptocurrencies. It offers real-time chart tracking, favorites management, multilingual support, and Firebase-based account management, making it the most practical way to manage your digital assets.
rocket.subdesc: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, and i18n, Rocket is optimized for both beginners and experienced traders. Explore the crypto market, invest, and track your portfolio in real time!

tictactoe.title: TicTacTerror - 3D Multiplayer Strategy Game
tictactoe.desc: An innovative platform that brings the classic tic-tac-toe game into a whole new dimension. Played on a 3D cube, this game combines strategy and fun with real-time multiplayer support.
tictactoe.subdesc: Players go beyond ordinary moves by using a bomb power-up to reset their opponent’s rows and columns. Every move is recorded, allowing users to revisit and watch specific moments of the match. Features include OTP-based phone number authentication, a dynamically ranked leaderboard based on win-loss stats, and room-code matchmaking for paired play. Developed using React, JavaScript, and Firebase.
